title: Health-related determinants of internal migration among older adults in Canada: a scoping review. Supplementary data and materials
description:
Supplementary materials for the scoping review Health-related determinants of internal migration among older adults in Canada: a scoping review, submitted to Populations (MDPI).

  • Table S1. Data extraction workbook for the 17 included sources of evidence, with the extraction table, summary tables and figures.
  • Table S2. Completed PRISMA-ScR checklist.
  • Claude_Prompts.md. Prompts given to Claude (Anthropic) during data extraction and manuscript preparation.

The review followed the JBI methodology for scoping reviews. The protocol is available at https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/4TNEH.
